BiblicalUsage: 1) to say, speak, utter; 1a) (Qal) to say, to answer, to say in one's heart, to think, to command, to promise, to intend; 1b) (Niphal) to be told, to be said, to be called; 1c) (Hithpael) to boast, to act proudly; 1d) (Hiphil) to avow, to avouch
